panels.title: Actionable Provider Quota Guardrails & Reset Forecast
panels.description: Per-provider quota table with automated SRE guardrail posture (Failover, Throttle, or Healthy).

config.title: Actionable Provider Quota Guardrails & Reset Forecast
config.description: Per-provider quota table with automated SRE guardrail posture (Failover, Throttle, or Healthy).

queries.query: SELECT COALESCE(gen_ai_provider_name, 'unknown') AS provider, COALESCE("group", 'default') AS model_group, COALESCE(bucket, 'default') AS window_bucket, ROUND(last_value(value ORDER BY _timestamp) * 100.0, 1) AS remaining_pct, CASE WHEN last_value(value ORDER BY _timestamp) < 0.15 THEN 'CRITICAL: Failover / Conserve' WHEN last_value(value ORDER BY _timestamp) < 0.30 THEN 'WARN: Throttle Sub-Agents' ELSE 'OK: Healthy Headroom' END AS sre_guardrail_status FROM "agent_quota_remaining_fraction" GROUP BY gen_ai_provider_name, "group", bucket ORDER BY remaining_pct ASC

panels.title: 3-Level Cross-Layer Telemetry Correlation Breakdown (Search vs Span Links vs Parent-Child)
panels.description: Classifies telemetry across Discussion #2573 correlation levels: L1 Search Correlation, L2 OTel Span Links, and L3 W3C Parent-Child Traces.

config.title: 3-Level Cross-Layer Telemetry Correlation Breakdown (Search vs Span Links vs Parent-Child)
config.description: Classifies telemetry across Discussion #2573 correlation levels: L1 Search Correlation, L2 OTel Span Links, and L3 W3C Parent-Child Traces.

queries.query: SELECT CASE WHEN service_name = 'openrig-telemetry-exporter' THEN 'L1: Search Correlation (openrig.queue.state)' WHEN links IS NOT NULL AND links != '' AND links != '[]' THEN 'L2: OTel Span Link (Causal Handoff)' WHEN reference_parent_span_id IS NOT NULL AND reference_parent_span_id != '' THEN 'L3: W3C Parent-Child Trace (Tool/Sub-Agent)' ELSE 'L1: Search Correlation (Root Agent Span)' END AS "x_axis_1", COUNT(*) AS "y_axis_1", COALESCE(service_name, 'unknown') AS "breakdown_1" FROM "default" WHERE service_name IN ('openrig-telemetry-exporter', 'agent-otel-bridge', 'codex-app-server', 'decider', 'mtn-signals-digest') GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY y_axis_1 DESC

panels.markdownContent:
### Executive Brief: OpenRig AI Layer & Model Economics
- **Subscription Tier Routing**: Governs allocation across `claude` (conserved for architecture & Second-Model Gate), `codex` (multi-file autonomous engineering), `gemini`/`agy` (discovery & synthesis), `grok` (fast iteration & adversarial review), and local `decider` inference.
- **Token Usage & Cost Provenance**: Provider-reported token observations, locally estimated cost, and subscription quota fractions remain strictly distinguishable (subscription usage is never conflated with invoice amounts).
- **3-Level Correlation**: Distinguishes Level 1 (Search correlation), Level 2 (OTel span links), and Level 3 (W3C `traceparent` parent-child spans).

panels.title: Token Usage & Cost Provenance Matrix (Provider-Reported Tokens vs Subscription Quota vs Invoice Cost)
panels.description: Separates producer-reported token counts from subscription quota fractions and invoice cost so subscription usage is never conflated with billing.

config.title: Token Usage & Cost Provenance Matrix (Provider-Reported Tokens vs Subscription Quota vs Invoice Cost)
config.description: Separates producer-reported token counts from subscription quota fractions and invoice cost so subscription usage is never conflated with billing.

queries.query: SELECT COALESCE(service_name, 'unknown') AS service_name, COALESCE(gen_ai_provider_name, 'subscription-cli') AS provider, COALESCE(gen_ai_request_model, 'default') AS model, SUM(COALESCE(gen_ai_usage_input_tokens, 0)) AS input_tokens, SUM(COALESCE(gen_ai_usage_output_tokens, 0)) AS output_tokens, SUM(COALESCE(gen_ai_usage_cache_read_input_tokens, 0)) AS cache_read_tokens, CASE WHEN SUM(COALESCE(gen_ai_usage_cost, 0)) > 0 THEN 'Provider/Locally Estimated Cost Reported' WHEN SUM(COALESCE(gen_ai_usage_input_tokens, 0)) + SUM(COALESCE(gen_ai_usage_output_tokens, 0)) > 0 THEN 'Producer-Reported Tokens (Subscription Tier — Not Invoice Amount)' ELSE 'Subscription Quota Fraction Only (Token/Invoice Data Unavailable)' END AS cost_provenance FROM "default" WHERE service_name IN ('agent-otel-bridge', 'codex-app-server', 'Codex Desktop', 'codex_exec', 'decider', 'mtn-signals-digest') GROUP BY service_name, gen_ai_provider_name, gen_ai_request_model ORDER BY input_tokens DESC, output_tokens DESC
